meta.title: Cutover — Standalone Local Login to External-Issuer-Only

views.label: Stage in (login stays on)
views.note: Add the other app as a trusted external issuer and prove its JWTs while /api/login still works.

views.label: Cut over + retire
views.note: Flip login_enabled to false, retire the SPA, and drop the local login secrets.

views.label: Rollback branch
views.note: Any failed check rolls back by re-enabling local login — both paths coexist until the SPA is gone.

components.label: 5 · Retire Angular SPA
components.sublabel: stop serving web/ statics — auth.users inert

components.label: Rollback
components.sublabel: login_enabled: true → restart — local login returns

boundaries.label: Stage in — local login stays on (login_enabled: true)

cards.title: Stage in while login stays on
items: One shared HS256 secret, coordinated with the other app, lives in .env — never in committed yaml
Their UI origin joins auth.jwt.allowed_origins (REST CORS + checker WS share the one list)
Prove the external JWT end-to-end: /api/me 200, mint works (maker) / 403 write (checker), checker WS connects

cards.title: External-only end state
items: login_enabled: false → /api/login 404s; the local issuer is no longer trusted
/api/logout stays registered — unconditional jti revocation for external tokens
With login off, ≥ 1 external_issuers entry is required or the plane refuses to start

cards.title: Rollback is one config flip
items: Set login_enabled back to true and restart — local login returns
Both auth paths coexist until the SPA is retired and the local .env secrets are deleted
Retire the SPA and clean .env only after the external path has proven itself
